description: AC wallboxes (EV chargers) with Modbus RTU for an energy manager: charging state, CP state, currents, voltages, powers, session energy, phase switching, heartbeat and charging release
source: MENNEKES, Modbus RTU Specification AMTRON 4You 300, Compact 2.0s, Start 2.0s, v2.5

sources.title: Modbus RTU Specification AMTRON 4You 300 / Compact 2.0s / Start 2.0s
sources.note: register table and the energy manager sequence

notes: Modbus RTU over RS485. Default bus parameters: 57600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits. Read with function 03 or 04; write with 06 (one register) or 16. Big endian, high word first.

An energy manager must write the heartbeat 0x55AA to 0x0D00 at least every 10 s, release charging at 0x0D05 and write a valid current (6 A to 16/32 A) to 0x0302. Values 0.01 to 5.99 A pause charging; 0 A means no limit. Change the current no more often than every 5 s.
Each entry says from which version of the Modbus register layout (register 0x0000) it exists.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Modbus Version
registers.description: Internal Modbus Register Layout Version (v 01.00 = 0x0100, v 01.03 = 0x0103). Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Firmware Version
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Serial Number
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: MENNEKES Article Number
registers.description: Article number as on the type plate, e.g. 1313201205 for AMTRON 4You 310 11. Since Modbus layout 01.03.

registers.name: EVSE State

enum.2: EV connected (no charging current is signalled to EV)
enum.3: Preconditions valid, but not charging yet
enum.4: Ready to charge (charging current is signalled to EV)

registers.description: Status of the charging station. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Authorization Status (RFID & Energy Manager)
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Downgrade
registers.description: Status of the external downgrade signal. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Phase Rotation
registers.description: Order of the connected phases (relevant for load management). Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: CP State

enum.11: B1 (EV connected, EVSE has not started charging yet or charging is paused by EVSE)
enum.26: A2 (EV disconnected, signaled current >=6A offered to EV)
enum.27: B2 (EVSE ready to charge, signaled current >=6A offered to EV)
enum.28: C2 (charging, signaled current >=6A offered to EV)

registers.description: State of the CP communication between EVSE and EV. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Signaled Current
registers.description: Signaled Current to the EV on the CP-line. Since Modbus layout 01.03.

registers.name: Downgrade Current
registers.description: Charging current limitation while downgrade is active. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Charging Current Energy Manager
registers.description: Charging current limitiation by Energy Manager: 0 = no limitation, EVSE signals maximal current (16/32A) 0.01...5.99 = invalid, EVSE signals 0A 6...x = valid, EVSE limits at its own upper limit (6…16/32A) Remark: 0x0D05 can be used additionally to interrupt the charging process. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Maximal Current House (DIP)
registers.description: Maximal installation current, configured from DIP-Switch, with attention to the house installation, configured by DIP-Switches 6-8 at bank S2: 0 - 63A; 1 - 50A; 2 - 40A; 3 - 35A; 4 - 32A; 5 - 25A; 6 - 20A; 7 - 16A. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Maximal EVSE Current
registers.description: Maximal current of the EVSE as configured during the installation: 0 - 32A in 22kW EVSE, 16A in 11kW EVSE 1 - 25A in 22kW EVSE, 16A in 11kW EVSE 2 - 20A in 22kW EVSE, 16A in 11kW EVSE 3 - 16A 4 -13A 5 -10A 6 - 6A. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Phase Switching Mode
registers.description: Phase usage possibilities while using the internal solar algorithm. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Phase Options HW
registers.description: Phase options regarding the hardware. Since Modbus layout 01.01.

registers.name: Cable Lock Setting
registers.description: Permanent cable lock. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Energy Manager Fallback Current
registers.description: Fallback behaviour when the heartbeat of the Energy Manager is not available during a charging session: 0 - Fallback handling disabled, EVSE will continue charging with the last received values from the Energy Manager 1 - Fallback handling enabled, EVSE will pause charging on heartbeat timeout 6...32 - Fallback Current 6...32A. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Grid Imbalance
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Grid Imbalance Threshold
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Grid Phases Connected
registers.description: Number of connected phases to the grid: 0: L1 is connected 2: L1, L2, L3 are connected. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Authorization
registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Solar Supported Charging (Sunshine+) Current
registers.description: Minimal charging current in Solar supported charging (Sunshine+) mode. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Phase Switching Pause
registers.description: Time between a phase switch from 1 to 3 phase and vice versa (in seconds). Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Current L1
registers.description: RMS output current of phase L1. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Current L2
registers.description: RMS output current of phase L2. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Current L3
registers.description: RMS output current of phase L3. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Voltage L1
registers.description: RMS output voltage of phase L1. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Voltage L2
registers.description: RMS output voltage of phase L2. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Voltage L3
registers.description: RMS output voltage of phase L3. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Power L1
registers.description: Actual power on phase L1. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Power L2
registers.description: Actual power on phase L2. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Power L3
registers.description: Actual power on phase L3. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Power Overall
registers.description: Actual overall power on all phases. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Temperature
registers.description: Temperature (°C) inside the EVSE. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Max Current Session
registers.description: Max charging current, evaluated out of all sources that could restrict the maximal allowed current and are static during a charging session (e.g. Installation Current Limitation, Charging Cable …). Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Charged Energy Session
registers.description: Energy transferred within the current charging session. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Duration Session
registers.description: Duration of the current charging session. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Detected EV Phases
registers.description: Maximum number of the detected phases of the EV during a charging session. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Heartbeat Energy Manager
registers.description: Write 0x55AA at least every 10 s to keep the Energy Manager link alive; otherwise the charger applies the fallback current. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Cable Lock Status
registers.description: Locking status of the cable. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Solar Charging Mode
registers.description: Internal Solar Modes can be indicated with the help of the Solar LEDs. Active charge mode. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Requested Phases

enum.0: regular charging on all available phases

registers.description: Requested phases when using dynamic phase usage. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Charging Release Energy Manager

enum.0: charging is not allowed (relais are opened)

registers.description: Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Lock EVSE
registers.description: Lock charging station (prevent charging). Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: System Restart
registers.description: Trigger a system restart by sending 0xBB once. Only use this function if the system is in IDLE state. Since Modbus layout 01.03.

registers.name: Active Error Code

enum.2323: Connected Phases mismatch (if voltage detection active)

registers.description: Error code in case of an active error. Since Modbus layout 01.00.

registers.name: Master Lost Fallback State
registers.description: Energy Manager fallback state. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Switched Phases

enum.0: regular charging on all available phases

registers.description: Information what phase is used or will be used if the EVSE will close the charging relay. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Charged Energy Total
registers.description: Cumulated charged energy in kWh on the AC-Port of the EVSE of all time. Not useable for billing. Since Modbus layout 01.02.

registers.name: Charging Sessions Total
registers.description: Total number of the charging sessions. Since Modbus layout 01.02.
